retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the non-proliferation treaty opened for signature on 1 July 1968. Its causes are the Chinese test of 1964 and the missile crisis of 1962, and its consequences are the safeguards system and the tests that broke it; the atlas holds no record of the nuclear age at all. Portugal ratified in 1977, having never had a programme, and there is no Portuguese record the treaty can be argued to have changed.
